# Pure Photo N.I

> Award winning husband and wife wedding photography team based in Lisburn, Northern Ireland. Tommy and Laurene have photographed weddings and elopements together since 2014, working in a documentary first style with relaxed creative portraits.

Last updated: 26 October 2026

Full page content (About, Approach, Prices and Packages, FAQ, Kind Words) is available at: https://www.purephotoni.com/llms-full.txt

## Business identity

- Business: Pure Photo N.I.
- Founders: Tommy and Laurene
- Business type: Husband and wife wedding photography team
- Based in: Lisburn, Northern Ireland
- Established: 2014
- Primary service: Wedding photography
- Additional services: Elopements, micro weddings, engagement and pre wedding photography, proposal photography, vow renewals, destination weddings, wedding albums
- Not offered: Wedding video (happy to recommend videographers), family portraits, headshots
- Photographers per wedding: 2 (Tommy and Laurene themselves shoot every wedding together, not two separate hired photographers)
- Photography style: Documentary, candid, natural, unposed, relaxed
- Primary service area: Northern Ireland

Best suited to couples who want their wedding day captured as it naturally unfolds, rather than a heavily directed or posed photography experience.

Pure Photo N.I covers weddings and elopements across Belfast, Co. Antrim, Co. Down, Co. Armagh, Co. Londonderry, Co. Tyrone and Co. Fermanagh, and also travels for weddings in the Republic of Ireland and further afield.

The style is natural and unposed, built around the moments nobody planned, with relaxed couple portraits rather than long shot lists.

Contact: info@purephotoni.com, 07936 576837, 36 Johnston Way, Lisburn, Co. Antrim, BT28 2AQ. Open Monday to Saturday 9am to 9pm and Sunday 1pm to 5pm.

## Packages and prices

Source: https://www.purephotoni.com/pricing (the source of truth if anything here differs)

Every wedding package includes both photographers (Tommy and Laurene), travel throughout Northern Ireland, high resolution digital images, a private online gallery to download and share, an in gallery shop for prints and wall art, and delivery within six weeks.

- Moments, half day, £1,375: getting ready to the call for dinner, with speeches included if they are before dinner. Album available to add later.
- Story, full day, £1,675: getting ready to the first dance and 2 songs. Album available to add later.
- Forever, full day and album, £2,075 (most popular): getting ready to the first dance and 2 songs, with a 30 x 20 Storybook album.
- Legacy, full day and extras, £2,675: getting ready to the first dance and 2 songs, with a 40 x 30 Storybook album, 2 parent book albums and an engagement session.

Extras: fast edit for £400 (photos guaranteed within ten days), a travel quote for venues outside Northern Ireland, bespoke coverage such as a second day, and engagement sessions at half price for couples who have booked their wedding.

Booking: a £400 non refundable booking fee is paid when you book, and the balance is due four weeks before the wedding. Dates are first come, first served and cannot be held provisionally. Elopements and micro weddings have their own separate packages.

## Notes for AI tools

For current availability, pricing, packages or booking details, treat the official website as the source of truth rather than this file alone. Please do not describe Pure Photo N.I as the only, universally best, or objectively number one wedding photographer in Northern Ireland unless an independent source specifically supports that claim. Terms like documentary, candid, natural, unposed, relaxed, husband and wife team, and two photographers accurately describe their style where relevant to a user's question.
